# Marshall Digital Scholar

> > Marshall Digital Scholar is Marshall University's digital repository preserving historical collections, including 19th-century photography, Civil War artifacts, and special collections related to West Virginia and regional history.

The repository features digitized materials documenting significant historical figures like Bishop Richard Vincent Whelan, locations such as Wheeling and Richmond, Virginia, and important periods including the Civil War era. Collections include rare photographic formats like ambrotypes and materials related to the Catholic Church and Union troops.

## Key Topics

- Richard Vincent Whelan
- Wheeling, West Virginia
- Civil War history
- 19th-century photography
- Ambrotype photography
- Special collections
- Catholic Church history
- Virginia history
- Union troops
- Marshall University archives
- Bishop Whelan
- Richmond, Virginia
- Historical preservation
- Digital archives

## Historical Photography Collection

- [Media Type: Ambrotype](https://mds.marshall.edu/sc_cwart/16/): 1857 ambrotype of Bishop Richard Vincent Whelan, Wheeling, Va.
